simple.summary: הָשֵׁם (Hâshêm) means Hashem , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 11 34.

definitions.full: H2044. Hashem הָשֵׁם proper name, masculine father of one (or more ?) of David's heroes 1Chr 11:34 , but read probably יָשֵׁן 2Sam 23:32 and strike out בני ; compare Dr Sm and see further below יָשֵׁן . הַשְׁמָעוּת see below שׁמע . הָשְׁפוֺת see אַשְׁמֹּת below שׁפת . הִתּוּךְ see below נתך . הִתְחַבְּרוּת see below חבר .
